content:
Noah Rivera: Quick sync: we need a minimal "smoke+canary" onboarding flow that is cheap but prevents obvious regressions. Ideas?

Chiara Moretti: Keep it two-stage: blocking smoke (3 prompts, deterministic) + async canary bench. Smoke must be <5s.

Ben Jacobs: For smoke include tokenizer hash, small kv warmup, and p95 latency. If tokenizer_hash differs -> fail.

Chiara Moretti: Also add smoke_profile tag so metrics are comparable across models (e.g., chat_short, complete_long).

Noah Rivera: Proposal for canary: start at 1% for 1h, monitor error_rate and latency delta; auto-rollback if error_rate > 5% or p95 increases >30%.

ops-bot: automation note: registering metrics: intake.smoke_pass, intake.smoke_p95_ms, intake.tokenizer_mismatch, canary.error_rate, canary.p95_delta.

Ben Jacobs: Interface: intake returns single acceptance payload string + registry stores full JSON: artifact_id, smoke_pass, smoke_profile, tokenizer_hash, kv_probe_ok, canary_policy. Keep payload minimal for deployer.

Chiara Moretti: Edgecases: allow manual override with verified_by and audit log. Also quarantine:auto tag if canary fails.

Noah Rivera: Action items: Ben to draft payload schema; Chiara to propose smoke prompts per family; Ops to codify the rollback thresholds. I'll add this to the RFC followup.

Ben Jacobs: I'll post the schema later today. Keep it small and backwards compatible.
